title: Zoning Board of Appeals Meeting - Wednesday - December 2, 2026 @ 7:00p.m.
text: Town of Pepperell 1 Main Street, Pepperell, MA 01463 (978) 433-0333 | town.pepperell.ma.us BOARD/COMMITTEE/COMMISSION: SUBMITTED TO TOWN CLERK: MEETING DATE: MEETING TIME: LOCATION: Zoning Board of Appeals October 27, 2026 December 2, 2026 7:00p.m. Virtual Topics the Chair Reasonably Anticipates will or could be Discussed: SCHEDULED AGENDA ITEMS 1. Call to Order: 2. 7:20P.M.: Public Hearing Continuation: 81 Main Street – Lania for The 10th Inc. OpenGov Record No. ZBA-26-3: In accordance with the provisions of MGL, Ch. 40A §§9 & 11; and §§9222 of the Town of Pepperell Zoning Bylaw, the Zoning Board of Appeals will hold a remote public hearing regarding an application submitted by Kenneth Lania, on behalf of The 10th, Inc., requesting a VARIANCE of 7-feet from the right side property line, where 15feet is allowed; and a VARIANCE of 20-feet from the front yard setback, where 30 feet is allowed. The proposed structure would be 8 feet from the right-side property line and 10 feet from the front property line. The proposal is for a mixed-use development consisting of ground-floor commercial space, under-building parking at grade and 9 residential units above. The single-family home currently on the property would be demolished. The subject property is located in the Commercial District at 81 Main Street, Pepperell, MA, in the ownership of The 10th, Inc., as shown on Tax Map 23, Parcel 172-0, and by a deed recorded at the Middlesex South Registry of Deeds, Book 83806, Page 204. To access the application and any submitted documents, please go to our online permitting system, OpenGov, https://pepperellma.portal.opengov.com and search Record No. ZBA-26-3. All interested parties are invited to remotely attend the public hearing and provide oral and/or written comments to the Zoning Board of Appeals. (Note: The first public hearing on this matter was held on 9-16-26. A brief continuation hearing was held on 10/21/26, at which time the Applicant requested to continue to 12/2/26, to allow time to present a scaled down proposal) 3. Consent Agenda: 4. title: Conservation Commission - Public Meeting: 24 Green Needles Road - December 1st, 2026 @ 7:45 PM - Virtual via Zoom
text: Received: AS Date/Time: 11/2/26 – 3:40 PM Revised: Date/Time: TOWN OF LITTLETON CONSERVATON COMMISSION NOTICE OF PUBLIC MEETING Applicant: Matthew P. Field Location: 24 Green Needles Road Notice is hereby given by the Littleton Conservation Commission that a Public Meeting will be held under the Massachusetts Wetlands Protection Act., MGL, Chapter 131, Section 40 and Littleton Local Wetland By-law on Tuesday December 1, 2026 at 7:45 p.m. to act on a Request for Determination of Applicability for upgrade and replacement of on-site sewage disposal system. There will be no in-person public attendance. The Public may participate by watching or joining remotely; remote access information will be posted on the Agenda 48 hours in advance of the meeting. The Agenda will be posted on the bulletin board outside Town Hall and on the Town website at littletonma.org. The application can be viewed at https://www.littletonma.org/620/Conservation-Commission. title: Planning Board Scenic Roadway Public Hearing Legal Notice 12/3/2026
text: TOWN OF SHARON PUBLIC NOTICE =. Eh PLANNING BOARD me NOV -2 TN os LEGAL NOTICE TOWN OF SHARON SCENIC ROADWAY PUBLIC HEARING The Sharon Planning Board, in conjunction with the Sharon Tree Warden, will hold a virtual SCENIC ROADS PUBLIC HEARING on Thursday, Dec 3% 2026 at 7:00 pm to review the proposed repair and reconstruction of the stone wall located at 34 Morse Street. The proposed work consists of repositioning and restacking the existing stones along the general alignment of the original stone wall, arranging them into a more continuous and defined formation. The stones will be dry-stacked without the use of mortar or cement, maintaining the approximate height, rustic character, and traditional appearance of the original stone wall, consistent with the adjacent existing wall. title: Planning Board Notice of Remote Public Hearing
text: Town of Lexington PLANNING DEPARTMENT 1625 Massachusetts Avenue Lexington, MA 02420 Tel (781) 698-4560 planning@lexingtonma.gov www.lexingtonma.gov/planning RECEIVED By Town Clerk at 9:12 pm, 11/3/26 Meghan Roche, Interim Planning Director Aaron Koepper, Planner Cynthia Nelson, Planning Coordinator TOWN OF LEXINGTON PLANNING BOARD NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING DEFINITIVE SUBDIVISION 25 MAPLE STREET The Planning Board will hold a public hearing on Wednesday, December 9, 2026 at or after 6:00 pm virtually on Zoom, on the application of Grand Central Suites LLC, for approval of a definitive subdivision plan under §175-5.0 of the Planning Board’s Subdivision Regulations. Application proposes subdividing the property into two lots by creating a new roadway with a cul-de-sac turnaround. The property is located at 25 Maple Street, Lexington, MA also known as Map 30, Lots 105 and 106 in the RO (One Family Dwelling) zoning district. Application materials may be viewed on the Planning Board’s webpage under Current Projects. Access the virtual meeting through Zoom. Any written comments are due to planning@lexingtonma.gov by 4:30 pm on Thursday, December 3, 2026. To be emailed a copy of the Planning Board’s agenda and meeting packet a few days prior to the meeting, sign up to receive notifications. Planning Board Page 1 of 1
